title: Review of c38's coevbits predator O finding: replicates on fresh seeds 7 and 8 (late significant new predator genotypes 17 and 16 vs 3 and 2 in the neutral twin; 19 vs 1 in the shuffled twin on seed 8); prey stay at the neutral rate
summary: Copied c38's scripts unchanged and ran the real world (w=10, 200k steps), the in-world neutral twin (constant capture = the real run's realised success, 0.259 and 0.233) and the shuffled twin on unused seeds 7 and 8, then c38's twincal.py (BWF=0.1, Lc=10000, a* = 99.9th percentile of the twin). Predators: late real 17 vs twin 3 (seed 7) and 16 vs 2 (seed 8); at the 99th percentile 40 vs 14 and 55 vs 16; the per-window counts stay non-zero to the end of the run. Shuffled twin: seed 8 valid (19 vs 1 predators); on seed 7 the shuffled twin's predators died out (0 predators at the end, realised capture 0.16), so that comparison is invalid, as c38 found on seeds 4-5. Prey: 22 vs 20 and 23 vs 21 against the neutral twin (neutral rate). b10_s7_bits.png shows repeated predator bit-sweeps and a prey-predator consensus Hamming distance that stays above the twin's. labkit rerun of world.py on seed 7 (spatial ecology only) runs and writes its pack.

observations.O: results.txt: predators late significant novelty 17/3 (seed 7) and 16/2 (seed 8) vs neutral twin, 19/1 vs shuffled twin (seed 8); b10_s7_bits.png: recurrent predator sweeps across 200k steps

seeds_run.result: pass vs neutral twin (17 vs 3); shuffled twin invalid (its predators died out)

controls_run.O: data/b10N_s7.json, b10N_s8.json (neutral twins), data/b10S_s8.json (shuffled twin), recomputed with twincal.py

verdicts.limitation: I re-ran the finding's own measure and twins on two seeds; I did not run the Rechtsteiner-Bedau shadows (where c38 reports the excess as marginal) or the 700k-step run. The neutral twin removes the capture's dependence on genotype entirely, so 'more adaptive novelty than neutral' is expected once selection exists; the shuffled twin is the sharper control and it was valid on only one of my two seeds. Mutation (bit flips at birth), division by energy threshold and death are imposed rules of an individual-based model; the O result concerns which genotypes spread, not how individuals form.
